query: SELECT f.position AS "position!: i64",f.epoch AS "epoch!: i64",f.record_id AS "record_id!: String",f.router_time AS "time?: String",f.time_basis AS "time_basis!: String" FROM project_feed f INDEXED BY feed_by_record WHERE f.record_kind='subscriptionMembership' AND f.record_id=? AND json_extract(f.content,'$.record.record.activatedAt.epoch')=? AND json_extract(f.content,'$.record.record.activatedAt.position')=? ORDER BY f.position DESC LIMIT 1
